criteria_outcomes.criterion: Map capabilities to needs without changing stipulated need text.
Treat supplied corpus and capabilities as stipulated inputs.

reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage satisfies the declared mapping contract: all eight handoff needs appear in coverage with preserved record_id and need text, supported needs receive the matching capability_id with direct coverage, and unsupported needs are marked none with an empty capability_id.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Order unsupported needs first and otherwise preserve upstream ranking.

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize correctly joins coverage to upstream provenance ranks and orders unsupported rows first, then covered rows by upstream rank. The two unsupported needs are priority ranks 1 and 2, followed by covered records in upstream rank order.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Produce the deterministic top-need recommendation and decision required by the execution contract.

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize retains the full bounded set of eight ranked priorities and constructs the recommendation from the first ranked record, producing decision prioritize and top_need isolate faulty execution branches before replay.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Select every qualifying demand row and preserve required fields.
Treat the supplied corpus as stipulated test input.

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand passes through the qualifying demand records from the stipulated corpus and preserves record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight for all eight records.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Preserve required demand fields through normalization.
Keep allowed corpus identifiers and bounded index window.

reviews.decision_reason: normalize outputs the bounded normalized needs DataFrame with the same eight allowed corpus identifiers and preserves record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight values.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Assemble ranked source provenance with deterministic ordering.

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance produces evidence_sources for all eight normalized needs with preserved record_id, source_id, source_weight and deterministic ranks 1 through 8. The downstream consumed handoff hash matches the upstream producer hash exactly.
